h1: Adda247: one coherent learning experience across a growing exam-prep platform
subtitle: Adda247 helps millions of aspirants prepare for India's competitive government exams. We redesigned modules across the platform around how learners actually study, so it works as one product rather than a set of separate features.

cta.heading: Have a learning product that needs this?
cta.body: Tell us where your learners stall. We'll tell you where we'd start.

sections.heading: Executive summary
sections.answer: Adda247's platform had grown module by module, each solving its own problem in its own way. Designit redesigned modules across the platform, from the test-series engine and live classes to the performance dashboard, content library, community and native iOS and iPad apps, around learners' needs rather than the platform's internal structure.
body: What changed is how each part starts from the learner: purchased content organised by learning need instead of by product SKU, live classes brought in-house instead of on third-party streaming, performance data turned into next steps instead of raw tables, and a native experience for Apple users who previously relied on mobile web.

sections.heading: Project facts
items: Learning platform on web, Android, iOS and iPad
Aspirants for SSC, banking, railways and other government exams; IIT/JEE aspirants; teachers
UX research, product strategy, UI/UX design, design system, mobile app design

sections.heading: The business problem
paras: Valuable features existed but were not surfaced: the Sankalp Bharat app's home screen was a generic feed that students scrolled and closed. Live classes ran on third-party streaming that the platform could not control. Classroom smart boards were barely used beyond basic whiteboard functions, and Apple users had no native app.
Each issue lived in a different module, owned by a different team, which is how platforms end up feeling like several products.

sections.heading: The user problem
paras: For learners, effort is the constraint. The test player created friction during high-stakes practice, with students losing track of time and navigation. Purchased content was organised by product package, so building a study plan was hard. Performance data was invisible or presented in tables that took effort to interpret.

items.title: Discovery with learners and teachers
items.body: Each module started with discovery and research into how its users study or teach, before any interface work.

items.title: Information architecture per module
items.body: Content reorganised around learning needs; the live class, test and dashboard flows restructured around the learner's task.

items.title: Wireframes and prototypes
items.body: Flows tested as prototypes before visual design, including state handling in timed tests.

items.title: Visual design and a shared system
items.body: High-fidelity design and handoff on shared foundations, so modules read as one platform across web, Android, iOS and iPad.

sections.heading: Key lessons
items: Organise by need, not by SKU. What learners bought is not how they study.
High-stakes tests need reliable state. Answers must visibly save and survive weak connections.
Data helps only when it suggests a next step. Raw scores discourage; improvement paths motivate.
Surface value where people already look. A home feed should lead with the platform's most useful features.

items.title: Homepage Revamp
items.desc: Revamping the Adda247 home screen to enhance onboarding, boost engagement, and drive free-to-paid conversion for 3M+ competitive exam students.

items.title: Test Series Enhancement
items.desc: Comprehensive upgrade of the online test-taking experience with real-time progress tracking, smart navigation, and detailed performance analytics.

items.title: Live Class Module
items.desc: In-house live streaming module replacing third-party services with real-time interaction, content sharing, and engagement tools.

items.title: iOS & iPad App
items.desc: Expanding Adda247's reach to Apple users with a native iOS and iPad experience following platform-specific design conventions.

items.title: Studio App for Smart Boards
items.desc: In-house application enhancing teaching with smart board tools for recording, annotation, and content sharing.

items.title: My Content
items.desc: User-centric content consumption redesign shifting from package-centric to learner-centric with clear progress tracking.

items.title: Community Module
items.desc: Building a collaborative community for peer-to-peer learning, doubt resolution, and gamified knowledge sharing.

items.title: Performance Dashboard
items.desc: Analytics that turn test performance and study patterns into personalised improvement paths for students.

items.title: Sankalp Bharat App
items.desc: Turning a low-engagement home feed into a personalised learning hub for IIT/JEE aspirants.

items.title: Mobile app design
items.body: iOS and Android, on real devices.

items.title: UX design for EdTech in India

faq.q: What did Designit design for Adda247?
faq.a: Modules across Adda247's exam-preparation platform: the homepage, test series, live class module, performance dashboard, My Content, community, a studio app for classroom smart boards, the Sankalp Bharat app, and native iOS and iPad apps.

faq.q: Which platforms did the work cover?
faq.a: Web, Android, iOS and iPad, with platform-appropriate conventions on each.

faq.a: Not on this page. Ask us on a call and we can talk through results we're able to share.
